issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (ConsoleLayout.jsx line 308 area — dev-tools wrapper on <option> content). Non-blocking, carried over since iter56.

critical_code_review_comments: There is no public GET /api/products/{id} endpoint — only PATCH/DELETE in routers/catalog.py and GET /products/{pid}/history in server.py. The ProductDetail.jsx page triggers GET /api/products/{id} (returns 405 'Method Not Allowed') in the browser (visible as 2× 405 in console). Not blocking because the page can be fed from the products list, but a dedicated GET endpoint would be cleaner.
_image_attachments silently drops attachments with http:// (non-TLS) or data URLs > 3MB; frontend should surface a user-visible error, not just an empty send.

orders_unread() scans the full conversations collection every call (regex ^order: + .messages projection), with Python-side iteration. Fine for a demo, but at scale this needs an indexed read_counter per (conv, user) or a Mongo aggregation.

demo seed_scenarios(): if a non-admin user calls purge, delivery_slots on real riders also get wiped (purge_scenarios unsets delivery_slots on any user with demo_slots_seeded=true — OK, but if an admin manually configured slots on top of demo they would be lost on purge).
server.py is 5651 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Keep splitting into routers (demo.py already extracted — good).
